description: This file defines data models for users and items, including database models, API schemas, and utility functions, for a backend application using SQLModel and Pydantic.

classes.name: UserBase
classes.description: Base class for user data with common properties.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new user, includes password.

classes.name: UserUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating user data, all fields optional.

classes.name: UserUpdateMe
classes.description: Schema for updating current user's profile.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user, with relationships to items.

classes.name: UsersPublic
classes.description: Container for list of public users and count.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Database model representing an item, with relationship to owner.

classes.name: ItemsPublic
classes.description: Container for list of public items and count.

classes.name: NewPassword
classes.description: Schema for password reset token and new password.
